scientific_integrity: Proof and analytic asymptotics supplied; independent review not performed. Finite numerical checks corroborate constants only.
scientific_limitations: The exact 3/2 threshold concerns the expectation of the off-diagonal Hilbert–Schmidt Gram sum, not an almost-sure divergence or a full interpolation threshold. The result only asserts interpolation for b>3/2; its literary priority is provisional.
title: A sharp logarithmic Hilbert–Schmidt threshold for random critical Dirichlet Gram matrices
